title: Can 50 Puzzles Cure My Blunders?
summary: Puzzle boot camp after a viewer-noticed blunder: he solves 50 chess.com puzzles rated anywhere from 0 to 2500 (seen: 1900, 800, ~2100-2200), talking through 'checks, captures and attacks' for each, and stops when all 50 are done.
rules: Sequence of 50 tactical puzzles of mixed rating (0-2500).
Each puzzle: find the forcing line (checks, captures, attacks); a wrong move fails the puzzle (streak row of green check squares shows progress).
Side to move varies (White to Move / Black to Move panel).

board.theme_notes: chess.com brown board with puzzle panel and streak row.

setup: Puzzle positions (no standard start); need a bank of mixed-rating tactics.
visual_fx: Green check streak squares per solved puzzle.
current_impl_issues: Legacy 'puzzle' single back-rank puzzle; should be a 50-puzzle run with mixed ratings and progress counter.
evidence: SRT 0:00 'today I'm curing my blunders with 50 puzzles the puzzles can be rated anything between zero ELO and 2500 ELO and we won't stop until we've completed 50 puzzles'; 0:40 'checks captures and attacks'; 1:40 'rating 1900'; 2:00 'rated 800'; 8:10 '2100 almost 2200'; 29:30 'we've completed 50 puzzles'.
